title: Read a quadratic-root function
description: You can follow the arguments and nested application used to construct two roots.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: roots accepts a, b, and c. Its body applies an anonymous function whose parameter is named discriminant.
The inner body constructs a list of two quotients. Its supplied argument is the square root expression on line 6.

steps.question: Does the supplied call return one root or a list of roots?
steps.answer: It returns a list containing two roots.

steps.description: For a = 1, b = 2, and c = -1, the output displays the list of roots.
